WITH date_series AS (
    -- Generate series for the months in the range of $__timeFrom to $__timeTo
    SELECT 
        generate_series(
            date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp)::date,  -- Start of the month for $__timeFrom
            date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamp)::date,    -- Start of the month for $__timeTo
            '1 month'::interval
        )::date AS month_start
),
daily_consumption AS (
    -- Fetch daily power meter readings from the database
    SELECT
        DATE(datetime) AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_power
        END AS "daily_consumption"
    FROM
        user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 105  -- Filter by form_id
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
        AND
    datetime >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
  AND 
    datetime < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
),
monthly_consumption AS (
    -- Sum daily consumption per month
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', dc.date) AS month_start,
        SUM(dc.daily_consumption) AS monthly_consumption
    FROM
        daily_consumption dc
    WHERE 
        dc.daily_consumption > 0
    GROUP BY
        month_start
)
SELECT
    ds.month_start AS month,
    COALESCE(mc.monthly_consumption, 0) AS "Monthly Power Consumption STP"
FROM
    date_series ds
LEFT JOIN
    monthly_consumption mc ON ds.month_start = mc.month_start
WHERE
    -- Only include fully completed months
    (
        -- Include the current month if fully included
        (ds.month_start = date_trunc('month', now()::timestamp)
         AND $__timeFrom()::timestamp <= now()::timestamp)
        OR
        -- Exclude partially included months
        (ds.month_start > date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamp)
         AND ds.month_start <= date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamp))
    )
    -- AND COALESCE(dc.daily_consumption, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100000  -- Ensure valid consumption range
ORDER BY
    ds.month_start;
